VI.description: Reads the GUI state of the thread thread ID through user32.dll GetGUIThreadInfo (stdcall\2C called in any thread) - which window of that thread is active\2C has the focus\2C has CAPTURED the mouse\2C owns a menu ... The GUITHREADINFO structure travels as info\2C 18 U32 that the function overwrites\2C with info[0] = cbSize. In 64-bit LabVIEW cbSize is 72 and each HWND is two U32 (low word first)\3A flags [1]\2C hwndActive [2\2C3]\2C hwndFocus [4\2C5]\2C hwndCapture [6\2C7]\2C hwndMenuOwner [8\2C9]\2C hwndMoveSize [10\2C11]\2C hwndCaret [12\2C13]\2C rcCaret [14..17]. In 32-bit LabVIEW cbSize is 48 and each HWND one U32\3A flags [1]\2C hwndActive [2]\2C hwndFocus [3]\2C hwndCapture [4] ... A wrong cbSize makes the call fail. return value is the Win32 BOOL\3A non-zero on success\2C 0 on failure. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: The GUI thread\2C e.g. from user32 GetWindowThreadProcessId.vi. 0 = the foreground thread.
Size of GUITHREADINFO in bytes\3A 72 in 64-bit LabVIEW (default)\2C 48 in 32-bit LabVIEW.
When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.

Indicator.description: The GUITHREADINFO structure as 18 U32\3B see the VI description for the layout.
Non-zero on success\2C 0 on failure (for example a wrong cbSize or a thread that does not exist).
error in\2C or the Call Library Function Node's own error.
